findings.subject: Primary endpoint ambiguity
findings.before: Appropriate action and/or function versus Phase C appropriate completed action
findings.after: Consistent time from locked eligible index to independently verified appropriate completed action; function and horizon completion secondary

findings.subject: Completion evidence versus appropriateness
findings.before: Completion field allowed independent or authorized verification without distinct structured clinical adjudication
findings.after: Source completion verification plus qualified independent adjudicator/rubric/decision/time/disagreement fields and both required for primary endpoint

findings.subject: ACS guideline clock
findings.before: Preferred six-month interval lacked explicit starting event
findings.after: Initial-test origin named and separated from team result-availability process interval

findings.subject: Linked identity and independent closure states
findings.before: No action/episode/question identifiers and single closure-scope field
findings.after: Stable episode/action/question IDs and separate action/question/episode closure status fields

findings.subject: Eligibility knowability versus assessment
findings.before: Assessment-named field meant time eligibility became assessable

findings.subject: Transfer versus competing event
findings.before: Transfer included in competing event examples without separating observation loss
findings.after: Separate transfer state, endpoint-precluding event and observation-end reason; explicit narrative rejects automatic competing-event classification

remaining_local_inputs: actual site and accepted clinical/operational/data/reviewer roles
complete applicable guidance review and local differential/urgency rules
capacity, resources, ethics/privacy and data-use determinations
track-specific qualifying-action rubric and procedure/evaluation adequacy
locked eligibility, index event, action components, horizon, estimand, analysis unit and allocation
adjudicator independence, masking, conflict exceptions, reliability and disagreement handling
repeated function instrument timing/version/language and missingness
authorized end-to-end clinical workflow and failure/rollback rehearsal
independent human decision and patient outcome evaluation
qualification: Ten document scenarios and six verified text corrections are neither clinical trials nor a clinical safety/effect rate.
